10001.Title: Prove Yourself
10001.Description: I know that you don't remember anything but this part of the world is quite dangerous. Before entrusting you with a proper weapon I need to see that you can fight. In order to prove yourself you need to exit the cave and kill some wolves. If you succeed to do so I will give you a weapon and your next mission...

10002.Title: Seek out the Woods
10002.Description: Consider me impressed. Not a lot of people would take on a challenge like that, I honestly thought you'd freeze to death or get eaten alive. Your next task is to gather wolf paws and walk westward to five them to my dear friend Seth. He will help you navigate this environment... There are creatures out there far more dangerous than some dogs.

10003.Title: Slay the creatures with horns
10003.Description: Wolf paws! That's exactly what I needed, thank you. I don't know what mysterious man you're referring to but I can help you get more acquainted with these woods. We have had a problem with some creatures that raid our camps at night. We've slain most of them around here but there is a cave north east from here where I bet you'd find some. I could give you some rewards if you bring me their horns.

10004.Title: Crimson Covenant
10004.Description: The blood moon rises, awakening an ancient vampire lord and his legion. Venture into the forbidden lands to forge an alliance with a reclusive coven of vampire hunters. Your quest is to unearth the lost artifacts that can break the Crimson Covenant and save the realm from eternal darkness.

10005.Title: Whispers in the Abyss
10005.Description: A haunting melody echoes from the depths of an abandoned elven city. As you explore the eerie ruins, discover the cursed lullaby that drives its listeners to madness. Your journey leads you through spectral realms and eldritch nightmares, seeking the source of the haunting whispers and a way to silence the ancient sorrow.
